concepts.anchor: before `## Sandbox and production testing`, add a new `## Marketplace transaction processing` section
concepts.proposed_markdown:
## Marketplace transaction processing

- [[source-braintree-marketplace-article-processing]] - article-level route for service-fee allocation, whole-transaction escrow and 30-day guidance, escrow-sensitive refund limits, and master-merchant refund and chargeback responsibility; distinct from generic transaction processing and not evidence of current Marketplace availability or eligibility.
warnings: Keep this as a minimal reciprocal route on the existing braintree-marketplace concept; do not create a competing generic processing or escrow concept.
Do not infer current Marketplace support, merchant eligibility, settlement of a particular transaction, or generic Braintree processing behavior from this collected article.
Preserve the whole-transaction escrow condition, 30-day recommendation, escrow-sensitive refund limit, and master-merchant refund and chargeback debit responsibility.
Keep article-level processing authority distinct from unread Node transaction-creation and release-from-escrow references.
